sloka: मया च रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन ।प्रशास्तु हीनो भरतस्त्वया सह ।पुरम् च राष्ट्रम् च निहत्य बान्धवान् ।ममाहितानाम् च भवाभिहर्षिणी ॥२-१२-१०८॥
transliteration: mayā ca rāmeṇa salakṣmaṇena ।praśāstu hīno bharatastvayā saha ।puram ca rāṣṭram ca nihatya bāndhavān ।mamāhitānām ca bhavābhiharṣiṇī ॥2-12-108॥

translations.english: With Rama and Lakshmana withdrawn from me, my kinsmen killed, let Bharata along with you rule the city and the kingdom causing delight to my enemies.
